teaser: Checking every output is a bottleneck and a weak safety net; put the person where it cannot be undone, and let controls do the rest.
core_idea: A person checking every output an agent produces is both a bottleneck and a weak safety net, because people approve almost everything they are shown; the person belongs where an output cannot be undone and the blast radius is large, given the why, while validators, second readers, boundaries and a record read afterwards check the rest, reviews fix the source, and the record moves the line.

nodes.label: Safety net or bottleneck?
nodes.summary: A roundtable question: few trust an agent to decide without someone checking every output.

nodes.label: Both, and mostly neither
nodes.summary: Checking every output does not scale and protects little, because people approve almost everything.

nodes.label: Approval fatigue
nodes.summary: Anthropic measured 93% of permission prompts approved, and cut prompts by 84% with sandboxing.

nodes.label: Agency is not a yes
nodes.summary: A yes without context, time or authority is liability, not a decision.

nodes.label: Where, not whether
nodes.summary: Place each output by whether it can be undone and its blast radius.

nodes.label: A person, with the why
nodes.summary: Sending in my name, typing a secret, spending money: a real decision, with the reason.

nodes.label: Controls that do not tire
nodes.summary: Validators, tests, leak scans, a second reader and boundaries instead of a person on every output.

nodes.label: Fix the source
nodes.summary: A review that turns a correction into a rule makes the loop need the person less.

nodes.label: The record moves the line
nodes.summary: Drafts nobody had to change are the evidence for giving an agent more room.

nodes.label: Production on 13 October
nodes.summary: Fourteen releases by agents with no one-by-one approval; an agent team that drafts all email and sends none.

nodes.label: Questions for the roundtable
nodes.summary: Six questions to place the person and remove checks that do not check.

quotes.text: So the honest answer to the roundtable's question is: checking every output gives you the cost of a bottleneck and the protection of a rubber stamp.
It is the same rule applied to two different blast radii.
quotes.why: Why the newsroom ships unapproved while email waits for a person.
